role: Maps the vanilla launcher asset store's indexes/<version>.json to on-disk object files so the default resource pack can locate assets by resource path.
scope_reason: Asset-locating plumbing for the launcher's asset store. The native engine reads the asset tree directly from a scene/assets directory (csrc/engine/raster.c loads atlas.json, table.bin and the .rgba sheets by path); there is no resource index or pack layer.

members.name: ResourceIndex
members.note: parses the launcher asset index JSON; no native asset index exists

members.name: field_152784_b
members.note: resource path to object file map

notes: Out of the GPU/RL path by construction: the C renderer resolves every texture and font sheet from the render scene directory, so no record of the launcher index layout is kept.
